unit.why: A single anecdote: the Maggid of Kozienice, unsure whether his fame comes from the Other Side, goes to his master R. Elimelech, who is sent by the angel Metatron to console him.

stories.start_quote: עו"ש הרה״ח ר׳ מאיר שעפס מקאזניץ
stories.end_quote: אז ידע כי נוכח ה׳ דרכו
stories.summary_en: The Maggid of Kozienice fears his rising fame may come from the sitra achra and goes to his master R. Elimelech of Lizhensk, who is asleep; the Maggid weeps bitterly at his lodging until R. Elimelech, woken by the angel Metatron, comes to console him and marvels that so great a hasid lives only twelve parasangs from Warsaw, which assures the Maggid that his path is holy.

tags.why: Disciple seeks confirmation from his master; the tale turns on the master's custom toward his disciples.
